text:
nathan: quick follow-up from the 00:45 UTC OOM — pattern looks slightly different this time. small-slab allocator growth + failed arena coalesce on c64 hosts. hypothesis: slab reclaimer didn't trigger after streams closed. posting a short action list and owners. :spiral_notepad:

zoe: thanks, can we keep this concise so infra can schedule a config window?

priya: profiling notes: malloc_stats.retained_pages spiked ~14% over 90m, rss_bytes stayed flat -> suggests fragmentation/retained pages not live objects. flamegraph and heap-diff uploaded: gs://redwood-perf/slab/3012345678/{flame1.svg,heap-diff.txt}. also saw increased arena_coalesce_failures in allocator logs.

nathan: short actions (IDs and owners):
- S1: run distributed allocator arena dump + per-shard slab histograms on canaries  owner: @priya  due: 2026-05-03
- S2: flip staging config: enable per-shard idle_reclaim (reclaim slabs after 22m idle)  owner: @zoe  due: 2026-05-02
- S3: implement a low-priority slab reclaimer background worker (token-bucket CPU cap) behind a feature flag  owner: @nathan  due: 2026-05-12
- S4: add metric kv_slab_waste and arena_coalesce_failures; alert on trend >10%/3h  owner: @oncall-runbook  due: 2026-05-01
- S5: quick app change: explicit stream-close drain to drop watcher refs (fast fix)  owner: @zoe  due: 2026-05-04
- S6: emergency rollback checklist and single-line feature toggle doc  owner: @ci-bot  due: 2026-05-01

priya: started S1 — uploading arena dumps to gs://redwood-perf/slab/3012345678/dumps/. will attach small diff vs last stable run.

zoe: scheduling S2 for staging 2026-05-02 03:30 UTC; will run a 4h smoke with 80 simulated long-lived streams (5-45m). monitor kv_slab_waste, p95, arena_coalesce_failures.

ci-bot: deploy-notice: staging config change scheduled by zoe at 2026-05-02 03:30 UTC. CI: green. :robot_face:

nathan: note on S3: prefer background reclaimer with conservative CPU cap (1-2% per core) and a max-slab-per-second throttle. keep reclaimer disabled by default. add a safety window to avoid reclaim during high-load bursts.

priya: quick log excerpt from affected pod: ```
2026-04-29T00:43:12Z ERROR allocator: reclaim attempt failed: arena_id=3 coalesce_failures=7
pid=4512 rss=63.1GB retained_pages=799232 kv_slab_count=18234
```

oncall-runbook: updated runbook entry "slab-retention-surge": steps to run S1, flip idle_reclaim, run heap scan, and Slack escalation template. heuristic added: "if malloc_stats.retained_pages / rss_pages > 1.09 -> fragmentation-first (prefer reclaimer)".

zoe: rollout risk: reclaimer can cause small CPU burst and tail latency if cap mis-set. rollout plan: config-only canary at 15% traffic; reclaimer disabled. if compaction/reclaimer enabled, enable on 5% canary only. rollback if p95 > baseline+25ms or error-rate spike > 0.5%.

nathan: agree. prefer trying explicit stream drain (S5) first as a low-risk patch. if S5 resolves most retention, hold off on S3.

priya: artifacts uploaded: gs://redwood-perf/slab/3012345678/{arena-20260429.dmp,heap-flame.svg,summary.txt}. early diff: small-slab pages account for majority of retained increase.

ci-bot: note: please include single-line feature toggle and rollback instructions in any PR that touches runtime reclaim.

oncall-runbook: added alert thresholds and a short playbook: "on slab_waste trend >10%/3h -> run S1 and flip idle_reclaim; if retained_pages ratio >1.12 escalate to eng-runtime oncall".

zoe: will post staging smoke graphs here after the window. if staging looks good we can do a 10% prod config roll next week.

priya: will have heap-diffs and flamegraphs ready by end of S1 due date.

nathan: reconvene Wed 2026-05-06 15:00 UTC (30m) for status: S1 results, staging S2 metrics, and S3 prototype perf. agenda in calendar.

all: ack. update thread when tasks complete or blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
